description: Somatic ATM mutation frequency across 32 TCGA PanCancer Atlas tumour types
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
API="https://www.cbioportal.org/api"

studies = requests.get(f"{API}/studies", timeout=60).json()
pan = [s for s in studies if s["studyId"].endswith("_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018")]
print("TCGA PanCanAtlas studies:", len(pan))

rows=[]
for s in pan:
    sid = s["studyId"]; prof = f"{sid}_mutations"; slist = f"{sid}_all"
    try:
        sl = requests.get(f"{API}/sample-lists/{slist}", timeout=60).json()
        n = len(sl.get("sampleIds", []))
        r = requests.post(f"{API}/molecular-profiles/{prof}/mutations/fetch",
                          params={"projection":"DETAILED"},
                          json={"entrezGeneIds":[472],"sampleListId":slist}, timeout=120)
        muts = r.json() if r.status_code==200 else []
        samp = {m["sampleId"] for m in muts}
        trunc = {m["sampleId"] for m in muts
                 if m.get("mutationType") in ("Nonsense_Mutation","Frame_Shift_Del","Frame_Shift_Ins",
                                              "Splice_Site","Nonstop_Mutation","Translation_Start_Site")}
        rows.append({"cancer": s["name"].replace(" (TCGA, PanCancer Atlas)",""),
                     "studyId": sid.replace("_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018",""),
                     "n_samples": n, "n_mut_samples": len(samp), "n_trunc_samples": len(trunc),
                     "pct": 100*len(samp)/n if n else np.nan})
    except Exception as e:
        rows.append({"cancer": s["name"], "studyId": sid, "n_samples": np.nan, "n_mut_samples": np.nan,
                     "n_trunc_samples": np.nan, "pct": np.nan})

df = pd.DataFrame(rows).dropna(subset=["pct"]).sort_values("pct", ascending=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",220); pd.set_option("display.max_rows",80)
print("\nSomatic ATM mutation frequency across TCGA PanCancer Atlas (n studies = %d, total samples = %d):" %
      (len(df), int(df.n_samples.sum())))
print(df[["cancer","studyId","n_samples","n_mut_samples","n_trunc_samples","pct"]].round(2).to_string(index=False))
tot_s = df.n_samples.sum(); tot_m = df.n_mut_samples.sum(); tot_t = df.n_trunc_samples.sum()
print("\nPan-cancer somatic ATM mutation rate: %d/%d = %.2f%%; truncating in %d (%.0f%% of mutated cases)"
      % (tot_m, tot_s, 100*tot_m/tot_s, tot_t, 100*tot_t/tot_m))

top = df.head(15).iloc[::-1]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10,7))
ax.barh(top["cancer"], top["pct"], color="#4C78A8", label="any somatic ATM mutation")
ax.barh(top["cancer"], 100*top["n_trunc_samples"]/top["n_samples"], color="#C44E52", label="truncating")
for i,(_,r) in enumerate(top.iterrows()):
    ax.text(r["pct"]+0.15, i, f"{r['pct']:.1f}%  (n={int(r['n_samples'])})", va="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("Percent of tumours with a somatic ATM mutation")
ax.set_title("Somatic ATM mutation frequency by tumour type, TCGA PanCancer Atlas\n"
             "Pan-cancer rate %.1f%% of %d tumours; %.0f%% of mutated cases carry a truncating allele"
             % (100*tot_m/tot_s, int(tot_s), 100*tot_t/tot_m), fontsize=11)
ax.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=9); ax.set_xlim(0, top["pct"].max()*1.35)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
